description: Mobile responsiveness fixes (Task P): audit SkillEvidenceHub.jsx, SkillGapPriority.jsx, CareerActionPlan.jsx for fixed widths and convert to responsive Tailwind classes. Independent of all other FEATs — can be done in parallel conceptually but is last because it is lowest risk and requires the other components to be in their final state first.
steps: READ frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/SkillEvidenceHub.jsx — confirmed it uses 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' which is already responsive. The header uses 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row' which is responsive. No fixed pixel widths found. Mark as already compliant — no changes needed.

READ frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/SkillGapPriority.jsx — the component uses 'space-y-6' and 'space-y-3' with no fixed widths. The WhatIfSimulator child component may have issues — read frontend/src/components/career/WhatIfSimulator.jsx. If WhatIfSimulator uses fixed widths (e.g. w-64, w-96, or inline style width), convert them to max-w-full or w-full with responsive variants. If it does not exist, skip.

READ frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/CareerActionPlan.jsx fully (offset 80 was not read). Check for fixed widths. The visible portion already uses 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row' pattern. If the rest of the file has any fixed-width containers (w-[Npx] or style={{width:N}}), convert to responsive Tailwind classes using sm:, md:, lg: breakpoint variants. Wrap any un-wrapped flex containers in flex-col with sm:flex-row.
SCAN frontend/src/components/career/SkillGapItem.jsx (if it exists) for fixed widths — this is rendered by SkillGapPriority. If it has fixed widths, apply same responsive treatment.
SCAN frontend/src/components/career/SkillEvidenceCard.jsx (if it exists) for fixed widths — rendered by SkillEvidenceHub. If it has fixed widths, apply same responsive treatment.

Ensure all three primary components (SkillEvidenceHub, SkillGapPriority, CareerActionPlan) use only responsive Tailwind breakpoint classes for layout. No inline style width values. No w-Npx classes without a responsive variant.
acceptance_criteria: SkillEvidenceHub.jsx: no fixed pixel widths in layout containers; uses sm:/md:/lg: breakpoints for grid
SkillGapPriority.jsx and its children: no fixed pixel widths in layout containers
CareerActionPlan.jsx: no fixed pixel widths in layout containers; flex containers wrap on mobile
cd frontend && npm run build — exit code 0
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — exit code 0
Open browser DevTools → toggle mobile viewport (375px width) → navigate to Skill Evidence Hub, Skill Gap Priority, Career Action Plan — no horizontal scroll, no overflowing content
